nodes.name: Template Pyrolysis
nodes.procedure: CoZn-ZIF precursor is subjected to template pyrolysis to obtain 2D MOFNDs, where the 2D hexagonal structure inherits the features of the precursor.
nodes.source_text: CoP4-SSC is synthesized via a template pyrolysis method... the 2D hexagonal structure inherits the features of the CoZn-ZIF precursor.

nodes.name: Phosphidation Exfoliation (300°C)
nodes.procedure: The 2D MOFNDs intermediate is treated with sufficient amounts of NaH2PO2 at a phosphidation temperature of 300 °C to direct strip atomic Co sites from nanoclusters and form CoP4-SSC.

unit_operations.name: Phosphidation and Exfoliation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: phosphidation exfoliation at medium temperature... When the phosphidation temperature was increased to 300 °C, and atomically dispersed Co sites can be identified on the CoP4-SSC sample.

nodes.source_text: followed by phosphidation exfoliation at medium temperature... When the phosphidation temperature was increased to 300 °C, and atomically dispersed Co sites can be identified on the CoP4-SSC sample

nodes.name: Phosphidation Variation (220°C)
nodes.procedure: The 2D MOFNDs are treated with NaH2PO2 at 220 °C, resulting in incomplete phosphidation and Co nanoclusters.
nodes.source_text: The obvious Co nanoclusters can be observed for the CoPx-220 sample treated at 220 °C

nodes.name: Phosphidation Variation (400°C)
nodes.procedure: The 2D MOFNDs are treated with NaH2PO2 at 400 °C, leading to slight sintering and agglomeration of Co sites.
nodes.source_text: increasing the phosphidation temperature to 400 °C causes slight sintering, as the clear agglomeration of Co sites can be detected for the CoPx-400 sample

nodes.name: Phosphidation Variation (500°C)
nodes.procedure: The 2D MOFNDs are treated with NaH2PO2 at 500 °C, resulting in severe agglomeration and the formation of CoP nanoparticles.
nodes.source_text: The agglomeration phenomenon becomes more severe when the temperature is further increased to 500 °C, forming CoP nanoparticles with diameters of 1.5-2.5 nm on the CoPx-500 surface
